_doc: Item-4 SHIFT leg. Each axis is a percentile in [0,1], 0.5 = neutral (no shift). shift = GAIN * (axis - 0.5) * role-or-lane-factor. See docs/item4_kernel_transforms.md.

movement_tweak._doc: Item 5 Movement TWEAK (docs/item5_movement_tweak.md). Per-player, modest, on top of the team SHIFT. tier base/plus picks the magnitude. effect: attack_band/defence_band = forward band SHIFT of that phase; spread = dilation of both phases about the base centroid, with an availability boost (budget >1).

_fan_doc: Lateral lane spacing for N>1 of the same central code at formation assembly. N=2 -> +/-0.5 lane (per chessboard_design item-3 banked rule). See formation_assembly.py.
